description: As a Mainer and a military veteran, I strongly support Sen. Susan Collins. In an “us versus them” political landscape, I believe Collins stands out as a dedicated leader who consistently puts the people of Maine ahead of party politics. She makes Mainers the “us,” no matter who the “them” is. Her remarkable work ethic […]
